name: Affinity Kitchens
notes: Cabinetry and kitchen design/remodeling firm with design showrooms, not a retailer of kitchen goods; no knives or cutlery on the site. Its own showroom page lists 7848 East Redfield Road #10, Scottsdale (https://www.affinitykitchens.com/contact/scottsdale-kitchen-design-showroom).

name: Jetta Bath & Kitchen
notes: Domain no longer resolves (DNS failure); listings describe a bath/kitchen fixtures showroom (decorative plumbing, cabinet hardware, bathtubs), not cutlery. Conflicting status: Yelp's listing title reads 'CLOSED' (https://www.yelp.com/biz/jetta-bath-and-kitchen-scottsdale-2) while https://www.theremodelingfirmllc.com/contact still places its showroom inside Jetta at 15250 N Hayden Rd Ste 2.

name: The House of Rice Store
notes: URL (on an unrelated cafe domain) returns 404. Listings described an Asian grocery/housewares store with kitchen items and cutlery, but it has closed: Sphinx Date Co. announced it is moving into 3221 N Hayden Rd, 'the iconic House of Rice' space (https://sphinxdateranch.com/blogs/news/moving-news-and-preorder-2025-harvest), and Yelp marks it CLOSED.

name: KoKoMo Grills & BBQ Islands & Outdoor Kitchens
notes: Outdoor kitchen retailer (built-in grills, pizza ovens, cabinets, refrigeration); a site search for 'knife' returns only grills and kitchen components (https://kokomogrills.com/search?q=knife). Homepage names 1325 E Gibson Lane as its central Phoenix showroom (https://kokomogrills.com/).

name: TriGreen Equipment
notes: John Deere dealer at 340 9th Ave N selling mowers, tractors, compact construction equipment and STIHL/ECHO/EGO outdoor power tools (chainsaws, blowers, trimmers), none of which is a drill; the location page lists no drills (https://trigreenequipment.com/location/franklin).

name: Cumberland Hardware Co
notes: Long-running neighborhood hardware store at 1018 Woodland St with current hours (Yelp updated July 2026; https://local.yahoo.com/info-14932034-cumberland-hardware-nashville/), but no listing or review mentions drills or power tools. The Facebook URL returned almost no content.

name: TreeHouse Foods - Naturally Fresh
address: 1000 Naturally Fresh Blvd, College Park, GA 30349
notes: TreeHouse is a private-label food manufacturer, not a retailer (https://treehousefoods.com/); the Naturally Fresh site is a dressings/sauces plant. Map listings still show Naturally Fresh at this address, but TreeHouse's site never mentions it and a CoStar headline reports the plant being sold, so current operation is unclear.

name: ampm
notes: Chain convenience store; the national homepage shows only food and drinks and says nothing about flashlights or headlamps (https://ampm.com/). A 24-hour ARCO/ampm operates at 7125 McCracken Rd per GasBuddy (https://www.gasbuddy.com/station/205206) and Yelp.

name: Califa Sports Store
notes: https://califasports.com/ has an expired TLS certificate, and behind it is a Network Solutions 'under construction' placeholder. Two web searches found no Califa Sports listing at 700 Edgewater Blvd or elsewhere in Foster City.

name: Outdoor Supply Hardware
notes: Site returns a Cloudflare 403 to automated fetches, but search-indexed product pages on the chain's own site list headlamps (e.g. NEBO Einstein https://www.outdoorsupplyhardware.com/2797444/product/Nebo-NEB-HLP-0005, Coast XPH30R, Energizer HDA32E); this is chain-wide, not Millbrae-specific stock. The Millbrae store at 900 El Camino Real has current hours (Yelp updated Sept 2026).

name: Summit Bicycles
notes: The bare-domain URL has an expired certificate, but the www page loads and shows the store open at 1031 California Dr. Its lighting category lists handlebar/seatpost bike lights, not headlamps; one Knog light includes a helmet mount (https://www.summitbicycles.com/product-list/accessories-1109/lighting-1130/).

name: The Gearage
notes: New and used outdoor gear shop at 142 Remington St with current hours (https://gearageoutdoorsports.com/). Its 79-item online sample (the site says it is not the full inventory) has no water bottles; the only bottle mention is a photo caption showing 'a Gearage water bottle'.

name: Toy Store
notes: The Mall of America directory lists this general toy store inside Nickelodeon Universe (Pokemon, Hot Wheels, Barbie, Schleich, Sanrio) but doesn't mention puzzles (https://mallofamerica.com/directory/toys). A mall holiday press release mentions Wicked puzzles but doesn't say which store sells them.

name: Cabela's
notes: Store page confirms the Hamburg store at 100 Cabela Drive; its listed departments (hunting, fishing, camping, clothing, home and gifts) include no lighting or bulbs (https://stores.cabelas.com/us/pa/hamburg/100-cabela-drive.html). The national site sells LED flashlights and lanterns and has a 'Lightbulbs' accessories category (blocked to fetch), with no evidence of household LED bulbs.

name: Boba Heaven Of Elmhurst
address: 573 N York St, Elmhurst, IL 60126, United States
notes: Bubble tea shop: its online-ordering page is a JS app, and its menu on delivery listings is prepared drinks (boba, fruit drinks, flavored teas, coffee), with no packaged tea. Active at 573 N York St with daily hours (Yelp updated May 2026; https://www.doordash.com/store/boba-heaven-elmhurst-25987060/).

name: Dreamers Gourmet - Specialty Food Manufacturer
notes: Specialty food manufacturer (taco shells, edible spoons, cannoli shells) run as a division of a foodservice company; no tea and no retail storefront. Site lists 4318 River Road, Schiller Park (https://dreamersgourmet.com/).

name: Milkteaful
address: 3122 W North Ave, Stone Park, IL 60165
notes: The Square Online catalog behind https://milkteaful.square.site/ is 50 prepared drinks (boba milk teas, iced jasmine green tea, smoothies) with no loose tea. The store location data gives 3122 W North Ave, Stone Park, with daily pickup hours.

name: Garden Gourmet Market
notes: Gourmet grocery at 1130 N Ashland (produce, cheese, fresh-ground coffee, wine, craft beer), active per Yelp updated Aug 2026 and DoorDash (https://www.doordash.com/en/convenience/store/garden-gourmet-market-chicago-2526442/). No source mentions tea; the Facebook URL returned almost no content.

name: Austin Coffee Technician
notes: Espresso machine repair service (by appointment) that also deals Rocket/La Pavoni/Rancilio machines; no pour-over gear on https://austincoffeetechnician.com/. Address conflict: its own site lists 217 Millington Lane, Buda, while Birdeye lists 2119 Frate Barker Rd #1101 (a search result suggests that is a live-work apartment building).

name: Embrace The Grind BTX
notes: Espresso truck; the Square Online catalog behind https://embracethegrindbtx.com/ is only coffee beans, a shirt and a sticker. Listed as an espresso truck at 824 Main St, Buda, on Yelp (updated Dec 2025) and Apple Maps.

name: Kyle's Daily Grind
notes: Cafe; its Square Online catalog (45 items) is drinks, pastries, whole-bean coffee, a tea box set and a T-shirt, with no brewing equipment. Site lists 607 West Center Street Unit A, Kyle (https://kylesdailygrind.com/).

name: Praxis Coffee Roasters
notes: Roaster cafe whose Square catalog includes some brewing gear (Baratza Encore grinder, Fellow Atmos canister, Fellow mug) but no dripper; its 'Pour Over' item is a brewed drink made with an Origami or Chemex. Site lists 10400 Menchaca Road, open daily 7a-2p (https://praxiscoffee.com/).
